text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since No Reason got injured, I brought her 
to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A little scratch like this would heal just 
by licking it, and yet...
choice_data_list: Licking it won't make it heal.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Salt, then?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "Wahahaha! Just a joke, just a joke."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Even I wouldn't go rubbing salt into an 
open wound, you know.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...I'll leave the treatment to you.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ooh. That is quite skillful! You have 
earned my praise!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Now we can resume training!
choice_data_list:
You're not fully healed yet, so let's hold 
off.

You shouldn't let your guard down, 
though...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That may be so, but... I really think I 
can still run just fine, though...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if that is what my tactician says, 
then advancing recklessly must surely be a 
mistake...”

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. For today, I shall quietly 
withdraw.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I won't overdo it. Yet it's 
also true that I feel ready to return to 
training.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Can't you do something about this, 
Strategist...? There's no time for rest in 
these Warring States.
choice_data_list: Got it, let's try adjusting it.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Alright! Let's get 
going then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, though I resumed training with 
No Reason—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Ouch...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It was heavier than I thought, eh... The 
pain's gone and flared up again.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It seems wise to treat today as a day for 
restoring one's vigor...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm...! At this rate, running shouldn't be 
an issue at all!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"This is also all thanks to your heartfelt 
nursing!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Alright, just do what you can, but make 
sure to get a good workout in!
